note: Shared Ground Delay Program advisory (ADVZY) reference cases. Transcribed from the vATCSCC TMI reference PDF cited by VATUSA/OIS#437 (the 'TMIs' document, 4 example advisories: GDP 002, Ground Stop 003, Reroute 004/005). The renderer is backend/src/advisory.rs (render_gdp); this file is what its tests assert against, so an example is written once and the document format cannot quietly drift. Every field is written out, null where absent, so a case reads as a complete advisory. The backend is authoritative: if a case and an implementation disagree, the backend decides which is wrong. Deviations are recorded per case in `deviation`.

cases.name: advzy-002-gdp
cases.why: The reference GDP, every field populated as the source prints it. Each line is load-bearing: drop a label, change its spelling, reorder the delay block, change the header's element slot, the period line or the signature and this fails. `ident.facility` is DCC -- the issuing facility -- and is deliberately NOT what the header prints, which pins that a GDP header carries the control element where a reroute header carries the issuer. Note FLT INCL appears twice, which is why the model holds a list.
cases.deviation: One. The source puts two blank lines between COMMENTS and the period line; this uses one, matching reroute-reference.json and render_reroute. The second blank is a page-layout artifact of the PDF, not a field.
